generator_policy: Two independent GPT-6 Astra ultra agents, user effort override of skill alternate-model default. Same-family, not independent model families.
consolidation: Near-duplicate families clustered mechanically; every original variant retained. No scientific-quality filtering before jury.

variants.title: 현재 VG의 확률적 support 선택으로 feature identity를 보존하는 SAE
variants.build_target: 기존 point-amplitude VG를 주 방법으로 유지하고, correlated firing에서 작동하는 학습·추론 recipe를 확정한다.
method_steps: 동일 unit decoder, bias, nonnegative amplitude 조건에서 full VG를 학습한다. gamma grid와 실제 native hard readout m>0.5를 사전에 고정한다.
동일 data worlds와 동일 checkpoint 기회로 L1/ReLU, Gated, BatchTopK, JumpReLU를 학습한다. 고정 regularizer 값 비교와 calibration에서 achieved hard L0가 가까운 비교를 모두 남긴다.
VG의 variance/entropy를 유지한 기본 recipe와 각 항 제거 control을 좁은 조건에서 비교하고, 실제 feature recovery와 signed mixing으로 필요한 항을 결정한다.
variants.hypothesis: **동일한 achieved hard L0 오지정 구간에서도 full VG는 L1 및 적어도 하나의 Gated/JumpReLU/BatchTopK baseline보다 signed feature recovery와 support F1를 높이며, 그 이득은 낮은 MSE만으로 설명되지 않는다.**

minimal_pilot.data: 5 features, d=20, width=5, p=.4; latent Gaussian hub C0j=-.4,0,+.4; independent train/cal/test; 3 paired worlds. QR orthogonal dictionary를 쓰면 새 controlled pilot라고 명시한다.
minimal_pilot.training: 2,000–5,000 steps의 좁은 regularization grid. BatchTopK K=1.8,2.0,2.2; VG/L1/Gated/JumpReLU는 calibration achieved-L0 범위를 덮는 사전 grid. 작은 baseline panel로 시작하고 2 GPUh 이내에 완료 가능한 후보 수를 runtime probe 뒤 고정한다.
minimal_pilot.primary: Matched signed cosine, fraction≥.95, hub signed leakage, support micro/macro F1, actual L0 bias and per-sample count MAE.
minimal_pilot.falsifier: VG의 apparent 이득이 achieved-L0 이동이나 MSE selection에서만 생기거나 JumpReLU/Gated의 회복을 재현하지 못하면 full-VG 우위 가설을 기각한다. Baseline 미수렴이면 비교는 불확정이다.

variants.selection: Oracle arm은 calibration ground-truth recovery로 checkpoint를 선택한다. Deployable arm은 사전 고정한 final checkpoint와 native threshold를 쓴다. 전자의 성공을 unknown-L0 해결로 부르지 않는다.
variants.risk: 현재 variance의 decoder gradient는 unit sphere에서 radial이므로 직접적인 mixing 방지 힘이 없다. Current VG도 잘못된 gamma에서 mixed features를 학습할 수 있다.

prior_work.overlap: Bernoulli mean-field selection, point amplitude, analytic expected quadratic risk and coordinate updates are prior art; the candidate contribution must concern the learned SAE dictionary and feature recovery.

prior_work.title: Improving Sparse Decomposition of Language Model Activations with Gated Sparse Autoencoders
prior_work.overlap: Separating feature selection from amplitude estimation and reducing L1 shrinkage are established; use Gated as a required control.

prior_work.title: Jumping Ahead: Improving Reconstruction Fidelity with JumpReLU Sparse Autoencoders
prior_work.overlap: Learned thresholds and sparse nonshrinking activations are established. Sparse but Wrong uses an Anthropic-style tanh sparsity implementation; identify that implementation separately from a generic JumpReLU label.

prior_work.title: Sparse but Wrong: Incorrect L0 Leads to Incorrect Features in Sparse Autoencoders
prior_work.overlap: Wrong sparsity can favor mixed dictionaries; c_dec selection and high-to-low sparsity scheduling are already discussed. The paper establishes neither general L1 failure nor VG correctness.

variants.so_what: 양성이면 가장 단순한 기존 VG 자체를 강화할 근거다. 음성이면 L1 제거와 mean-field Bernoulli objective만으로 부족함을 보여 주고, 다음 후보가 고칠 원인을 한정한다. 이 비교가 별도의 진단 논문으로 주 목표를 바꾸지는 않는다.
variants.novelty_boundary: Support/amplitude 분리 또는 analytic variance의 최초 주장이 아니라, 해당 VG objective가 배운 dictionary의 feature 복원에 주는 추가 가치가 후보 기여다.

variants.title: 기본 VG를 feature 복원 중심으로 완성하기
variants.one_sentence_summary: 현재 VG의 support/amplitude 분리와 analytic risk를 유지한 채, 잘못된 sparsity 설정에서 실제 feature를 보존하는 운영 영역을 L1와 hard-L0 baseline에 대해 규명한다.
what_we_build: 동일 correlated toy에서 현재 VG, L1, rescaled L1, Gated, BatchTopK, JumpReLU를 같은 5-control 및 checkpoint 예산으로 학습한다.
Calibration에서 low/correct/high native-hard L0 operating point를 동결하고 각 방법의 signed dictionary와 support를 fresh test에서 평가한다.
VG의 full objective와 no-variance control을 작은 두 correlation 조건에서 비교해 generic amplitude 분리 이상의 신호가 있는지 확인한다.
variants.bold_falsifiable_hypothesis: **기본 VG는 양·음의 firing correlation 모두에서 L1와 BatchTopK보다 넓은 realized-L0 구간에서 참 feature를 유지하며, 그 이득 일부는 rescaled L1와 Gated를 통제한 뒤에도 남는다.**

minimal_pilot.design: Common toy, 3 correlations x 3 paired seeds, 5 controls per method. Share this screen with subsequent selected pilots. A bounded scout may reduce the common grid to 3 controls before result inspection, retaining low/correct/high coverage.
minimal_pilot.positive: At least two paired seeds in each nonzero correlation sign show a >=.05 mean signed cosine gain or >=.20 recovered-feature-fraction gain with lower leakage against L1 and BatchTopK across at least two adjacent attained-L0 points; Gated/JumpReLU comparisons are reported even if they erase the VG margin.
minimal_pilot.negative: Adequately converged VG has no identity/leakage advantage after rescaling/Gated control, or only an MSE advantage; the stronger VG-specific hypothesis fails.
minimal_pilot.null: No model reaches a positive-control recovery region or the coefficient grid fails to bracket L0; repair the protocol before interpreting.
minimal_pilot.unlabeled_selection: Report c_dec minimum as an explicitly fallible fixed comparator and oracle-cal recovery as a separate ceiling; neither is labeled automatic L0 discovery.

variants.scientific_value_even_if_negative: A negative result identifies exactly whether the original VG objective needs a mechanism change; it prevents spending the full research budget improving a reconstruction frontier that hides mixed features.

risk.named_failure: VG may merely exchange amplitude shrinkage for density changes; JumpReLU/Gated may match or dominate recovery.

closest_prior_annotations.relation: Supplies the incorrect-L0/mixing challenge and strong BatchTopK/JumpReLU comparators; does not prove this hypothesis.
Current VG objective lineage; success would be a learned-dictionary result, not a new variational principle.
Direct control for support/amplitude separation; must not claim that separation alone is new.

variants.title: 정규화된 Bernoulli prior를 학습하는 VG-SAE
variants.build_target: true L0를 입력하지 않고 scalar gamma를 적응시키는 최소 VG 확장.
method_steps: run-local loss에 gamma·sum(m)+J·softplus(-gamma)를 tensor 연산으로 구현하고, gamma 고정 시 기존 objective와 수치 일치를 확인한다.
gamma를 gradient로 학습하거나 train minibatch의 mean(m)에 따른 detached alternating update로 학습한다. 두 구현을 동시에 새 방법으로 묶지 말고 하나를 사전에 고른다.
초기 gamma를 세 값으로 바꾸어 같은 recipe를 p=.2,.4,.6 조건으로 전이한다. Native threshold .5와 training budget을 유지하고 support/L0 정답은 update에 쓰지 않는다.
variants.hypothesis: **정규화된 prior 적응은 source에서 고정한 gamma보다 density-transfer에서 feature recovery와 native hard-count 정확도를 함께 보존하며, 세 초기 gamma에 대한 결과 차이를 줄인다.**

minimal_pilot.data: d=20, g=5, width=5; p=.2,.4,.6; feasible positive/negative Gaussian-copula correlation; 3 paired worlds, independent streams.
minimal_pilot.training: Fixed-gamma transfer, learned-gamma VG, calibration oracle grid ceiling. 3 gamma initializations; objective and hard inference fixed. Narrow positive/negative subsets first; endpoint collapse logged.
minimal_pilot.primary: Transfer recovery, signed leakage, support F1, hard-count MAE, initialization range; track pi, mean(m), entropy and beta.
minimal_pilot.falsifier: pi=mean(m)처럼 자기 일관성만 맞고 hard count·recovery가 틀리거나 초기 gamma에 의해 다른 collapse가 유지되면 실패다.

variants.selection: Deployable update and final checkpoint use x only. True-L0/feature based oracle selection is a separately labeled ceiling; no test labels enter gamma learning.
variants.risk: Stationarity pi=mean(m)는 unknown true L0 identification 정리가 아니다. Point amplitude, duplicated columns, width와 beta가 자기확증 밀도에 영향을 줄 수 있다.

prior_work.overlap: Bernoulli mean-field selection, point amplitude, analytic expected quadratic risk and coordinate updates are prior art; the candidate contribution must concern the learned SAE dictionary and feature recovery.

prior_work.title: Bayes and empirical-Bayes multiplicity adjustment in the variable-selection problem
prior_work.overlap: Learning inclusion probabilities and its multiplicity/degeneracy issues are old; adapting this principle alone is not novel.

prior_work.title: Sparse but Wrong: Incorrect L0 Leads to Incorrect Features in Sparse Autoencoders
prior_work.overlap: Wrong sparsity can favor mixed dictionaries; c_dec selection and high-to-low sparsity scheduling are already discussed. The paper establishes neither general L1 failure nor VG correctness.

variants.so_what: 양성이면 sparsity knob 전이 문제를 줄이는 작고 배포 가능한 VG recipe다. 음성이면 scalar empirical-Bayes self-consistency가 feature identity를 고르는 정보를 충분히 제공하지 않는다는 방법 설계 근거다.
variants.novelty_boundary: Empirical Bayes 최초 주장 금지. Correlation과 unknown density 아래 VG feature recovery의 조건부 개선이 검증 대상이다.

variants.title: 정규화된 support prior를 학습하는 VG
variants.one_sentence_summary: 고정 gamma를 미분 가능한 scalar로 바꿔 density를 데이터와 함께 추정하고, 참 L0 없이 feature 복원이 유지되는지 검증한다.
what_we_build: 별도 pilot loss에서 gamma*sum(m)+J*softplus(-gamma)를 tensor로 구현하고 고정 gamma일 때 기존 loss와 일치시킨다.
같은 encoder/decoder로 gamma를 학습하되 세 초기값을 사용해 자기확인적 density에 갇히는지 측정한다.
Source에서 정한 학습 규칙을 p=.2/.4/.6의 target toy에 그대로 적용하고 fixed-gamma transfer와 비교한다.
variants.bold_falsifiable_hypothesis: **정규화 prior의 scalar adaptation은 초기 gamma와 marginal firing density가 달라도 fixed-gamma transfer보다 높은 dictionary identity를 보존하며, true-L0 oracle 없이 적정 operating region에 도달한다.**

minimal_pilot.design: Corr ±.4 at p=.4 first, then p=.2/.6 only if the first arms fit the cap; 3 initial gamma values x 3 paired seeds. Compare fixed-gamma source recipe and existing B01 oracle envelope.
minimal_pilot.positive: Unlabeled adapted VG stays within .05 signed cosine of the oracle-cal VG ceiling across initializations and improves target recovery over fixed source gamma; no endpoint collapse.
minimal_pilot.negative: Prior estimates strongly depend on initialization or co-adapt with an incorrect dense/mixed dictionary despite lower loss.
minimal_pilot.null: Gamma reaches clamps or beta/risk floor dominates; this is numerical failure rather than evidence that true L0 is identifiable.
minimal_pilot.stationarity: pi=mean(m) is only self-consistency. Neither that equality nor closeness of expected L0 to 2 is a recovery proof.

variants.scientific_value_even_if_negative: Directly tests whether original VG can become usable without a known sparsity budget. Failure exposes self-confirmation rather than suggesting the user abandon VG-SAE.

risk.named_failure: Learned density can rationalize a wrong dictionary; prior frequency and true feature identity are not identifiable from stationarity alone.

closest_prior_annotations.relation: Normalized support prior is established; empirical-Bayes-style fitting is not intrinsically novel.
Adaptive activation-count competitor still has lambda_AFA; compare usable selection, not rhetoric about no k.
Existing unlabeled complexity-selection perspective; learned gamma does not replace all model-selection assumptions.

variants.title: 희귀 feature를 위한 shrinkage된 feature별 VG prior
variants.build_target: 모든 latent에 같은 gamma를 강제하는 대신 feature별 사용빈도와 전역 희소성 정보를 분리한다.
method_steps: 각 latent에 pi_j를 두고 normalized Bernoulli KL을 계산한다. pi_j의 train-only posterior-count update를 공유 전역 pi로 shrink하여 rare/dead feature의 조기 극단화를 막는다.
처음에는 decoder와 gate를 전역 prior로 warmup한 뒤 per-latent prior를 연다. Shrinkage 강도와 warmup은 source condition에서 고정한다.
동일 수의 train examples에서 global learned prior, unshrunk independent priors, shrunk priors를 비교한다. 회복한 rare features와 frequent features를 별도로 평가한다.
variants.hypothesis: **약하게 공유된 feature별 prior는 global gamma 대비 빈도 불균형과 correlated firing 조건에서 rare-feature recall을 높이면서 frequent-feature leakage와 false-positive support를 늘리지 않는다.**

minimal_pilot.data: 5-feature toy의 p_j를 .10,.20,.30,.40,.50으로 바꾸고 hub correlation±.4/0를 사용; 3 worlds. Orthogonal true dictionary에서 시작해 frequency와 geometric coherence를 분리한다.
minimal_pilot.training: Global learned prior / independent pi_j / shared-shrinkage pi_j, 2,000–5,000 updates; 2 initial gate biases; fixed recipe.
minimal_pilot.primary: Macro support F1, frequency-quartile recall, signed dictionary coverage, hard L0 distribution and leakage.
minimal_pilot.falsifier: Rare-feature recall 개선 없이 frequent codes만 복제하거나 global sparsity 이동을 맞춘 뒤 이득이 사라지면 실패다.

variants.selection: 빈도 정답 p_j는 평가에만 사용한다. Prior update는 learned training gates만 사용하고 oracle feature alignment는 cal에서 정한 후 test에 고정한다.
variants.risk: 희귀하고 아직 찾지 못한 feature는 낮은 posterior count로 더 죽을 수 있다. Beta/pseudocount와 width dependence가 추가되어 tuning-free 주장은 불가능하다.

prior_work.overlap: Bernoulli mean-field selection, point amplitude, analytic expected quadratic risk and coordinate updates are prior art; the candidate contribution must concern the learned SAE dictionary and feature recovery.

prior_work.title: Bayesian Inference for Structured Spike and Slab Priors
prior_work.overlap: Structured inclusion priors are established. This candidate begins with marginal heterogeneity rather than claiming full support dependence modeling.

prior_work.title: Jumping Ahead: Improving Reconstruction Fidelity with JumpReLU Sparse Autoencoders
prior_work.overlap: Learned thresholds and sparse nonshrinking activations are established. Sparse but Wrong uses an Anthropic-style tanh sparsity implementation; identify that implementation separately from a generic JumpReLU label.

variants.so_what: 양성이면 폭과 빈도가 커질 때 쓸 수 있는 VG prior를 얻는다. 음성이면 feature-frequency adaptation이 rare-feature starvation의 해결책인지, self-reinforcement인지 구분하여 복잡도를 줄일 수 있다.
variants.novelty_boundary: Per-feature sparsity thresholds/prior라는 일반 개념은 선행이다. VG normalized probability update의 실제 rare-feature identity 보존이 필요한 추가 증거다.

variants.title: 동일한 최종 VG objective에 도달하는 support continuation
variants.build_target: 학습 초기의 과도한 누락이 decoder mixing을 고착하는 현상을 줄이는 VG training recipe.
method_steps: 초기 gamma를 낮춰 충분한 support를 허용하고, 정해진 steps 동안 최종 gamma로 증가시킨다. 기본 실험에서는 entropy weight=1과 variance를 유지해 schedule 한 가지부터 검사한다.
Constant gamma와 continuation을 최종 gamma, 총 steps, final-phase steps 및 checkpoint 후보 수를 명시해 비교한다. 필요하면 더 긴 constant control로 단순 학습량 차이를 점검한다.
학습 trajectory에서 matched decoder identity와 native L0가 언제 변하는지 기록하고, 최종 25% steps는 동일 stationary objective로 학습한다.
variants.hypothesis: **동일 최종 gamma와 유사한 realized hard L0에서 high-support warmup은 constant-sparsity VG보다 correlated feature mixing을 줄이고, 학습 후반 MSE 개선과 recovery 악화의 동반 발생을 줄인다.**

minimal_pilot.data: Small 5-feature±.4/0 world, 3 paired seeds; final achieved L0가 약1.8,2.0,2.2 부근이 되는 gamma 세 개를 calibration에서만 보고한다.
minimal_pilot.training: Constant / linear gamma warmup / reverse warmup, same total steps. Ground-truth dictionary initialization은 mechanism-only arm이며 random initialization이 primary다.
minimal_pilot.primary: Final signed recovery and leakage; trajectory identity loss; hard-count error and support F1.
minimal_pilot.falsifier: Final achieved L0 또는 total updates를 맞추면 이득이 사라지거나 reverse schedule도 동등하면 제안한 early-omission 기전을 지지하지 못한다.

variants.selection: Schedule은 source condition에서 고정하여 모든 correlation conditions에 적용한다. Final gamma를 true recovery로 고른 arm은 oracle로 분리한다.
variants.risk: 최종 gamma가 실제로 부적절하면 충분한 후반 학습에서 mixing이 다시 나타날 수 있다. Warmup이 objective의 문제를 잠시 지연시키는 결과일 수 있다.

prior_work.title: Sparse but Wrong: Incorrect L0 Leads to Incorrect Features in Sparse Autoencoders
prior_work.overlap: Wrong sparsity can favor mixed dictionaries; c_dec selection and high-to-low sparsity scheduling are already discussed. The paper establishes neither general L1 failure nor VG correctness.

prior_work.title: The Variational Garrote
prior_work.overlap: Bernoulli mean-field selection, point amplitude, analytic expected quadratic risk and coordinate updates are prior art; the candidate contribution must concern the learned SAE dictionary and feature recovery.

prior_work.title: SoftSAE: Dynamic Top-K Selection for Adaptive Sparse Autoencoders
prior_work.overlap: Soft-to-hard schedules and adaptive support are nearby work; SoftSAE retains K/k_max/k-loss controls. This candidate does not claim scheduling itself is new.

variants.so_what: 양성이면 architecture 추가 없이 VG feature recovery를 안정화한다. 음성이면 optimizer trajectory만 바꿔서는 최종 sparsity-pressure 실패를 고치기 어렵다는 근거다.
variants.novelty_boundary: Sparse but Wrong가 high-to-low L0 scheduling을 이미 다룬다. VG-specific gain과 gamma/entropy 기전의 정량적 차이가 있어야 독립 기여가 된다.

variants.title: 희소화 강도를 늦게 올리는 VG 학습
variants.one_sentence_summary: Decoder가 feature 방향을 먼저 배울 시간을 주고 같은 최종 gamma에 도달하도록 prior 강도만 연속적으로 올린다.
what_we_build: VG의 gamma를 낮은 값에서 시작해 고정한 최종 값으로 선형 또는 단일 smooth schedule로 올린다; 다른 loss term과 head는 유지한다.
동일 최종 gamma의 처음부터 고정한 학습과 reverse schedule을 같은 sample budget으로 비교한다.
마지막 25% update는 모든 조건을 최종 objective에 고정하고 dictionary trajectory와 hard recovery를 비교한다.
variants.bold_falsifiable_hypothesis: **동일 최종 gamma와 비슷한 attained hard L0에서도 늦은 희소화는 초기에 생기는 hub mixing을 줄이고, 양·음의 상관 모두에서 최종 true-feature 복원을 개선한다.**

minimal_pilot.design: Corr ±.4, 3 paired seeds, two final gamma values selected by B01 calibration to straddle the low/correct L0 region; 3 schedules, common 2000 updates.
minimal_pilot.positive: Warm-start schedule improves signed matched cosine >=.05 and lowers leakage in at least 2/3 seeds of both signs, with final native-hard L0 within .1 or separately density-matched confirmation.
minimal_pilot.negative: The benefit vanishes during the common final-objective tail or is explained by a different final L0; schedule is not a stable remedy.
minimal_pilot.null: Both schedules remain far from positive-control recovery; do not interpret absent benefit as proof of irreversibility.
minimal_pilot.unlabeled_selection: Start/final fields are fixed from training-independent protocol or source calibration; test true L0 is never used to stop the schedule.

variants.scientific_value_even_if_negative: Separates a repairable training-path issue from an objective preference for mixed features, yielding a simpler final VG recipe if positive and clear limits if negative.

risk.named_failure: Dense warmup can itself learn rotated representations; the final sparse objective may eventually recover the same wrong solution.

closest_prior_annotations.relation: Already studies high-to-low sparsity scheduling; this is a VG-specific implementation/interaction test, not a claim to invent warmup.
Spike warm-up is prior art. Differentiate only by evidence about VG free-energy trajectories and feature recovery.

variants.title: VG coordinate evidence를 학습 중 gate head에 전달하기
variants.build_target: 느린 test-time solver 없이 amortized gate가 residual evidence를 더 정확하게 사용하도록 학습한다.
method_steps: 현재 decoder와 amplitude를 고정한 coordinate Bernoulli optimum의 logit을 계산한다: beta·(a_j d_j^T r_-j - .5 a_j²||d_j||²)-gamma. Unit entropy 조건에서 deterministic enumeration으로 확인한다.
매 일부 minibatch마다 simultaneous 또는 순차 한 sweep의 teacher gate를 계산해 detach하고 gate head에 distill한다. 독립 mean-field objective와 teacher approximation의 차이를 명시한다.
Decoder는 full VG objective로 학습하며 test-time에는 기존 한 번의 encoder만 사용한다. 동일 FLOPs의 추가 training steps와 generic amplitude-only teacher를 비교한다.
variants.hypothesis: **학습 중 한 단계의 VG support-evidence distillation은 inference latency를 거의 유지하면서 gate omission의 residual correlation을 줄여, 단순 추가 학습보다 learned decoder mixing과 support FN를 줄인다.**

minimal_pilot.data: 5-feature positive/negative correlation, p=.4, 3 worlds; random initialization primary.
minimal_pilot.training: Full VG / full VG with one-step gate teacher / extra-step compute control / amplitude-only teacher. Teacher every 4 minibatches부터 고정; prior grid는 작게 유지.
minimal_pilot.primary: Signed recovery, support FN/FP, off-diagonal leakage, per-example inference latency and training FLOPs.
minimal_pilot.falsifier: 개선이 fixed-D readout에만 있고 learned dictionary가 좋아지지 않거나 generic amplitude teacher/compute control을 넘지 못하면 VG-specific train-time correction 가설 실패다.

variants.selection: Teacher는 train x와 learned D,m,a만 사용한다. Ground-truth support를 distillation target으로 쓰지 않는다. Native threshold remains .5.
variants.risk: 동시 업데이트는 exact coordinate descent와 다르고, 잘못된 dictionary의 posterior optimum을 더 잘 흉내 낼 수 있다. 기존 P3/P3b의 높은 inference 비용과 작은 추가 이득이 재발할 수 있다.

variants.so_what: 양성이면 analytic VG inference를 배포 가능한 encoder 학습으로 연결한다. 음성이면 gate amortization이 feature mixing의 주요 원인이 아니라는 근거로 solver 중심 개발을 중단할 수 있다.
variants.novelty_boundary: Coordinate inference/teacher 자체는 새롭지 않다. Full dictionary learning에서 발생하는 VG-specific feature recovery 이득과 비용이 핵심이다.

variants.title: 잔차 기반 support teacher를 단일 forward VG에 학습하기
variants.one_sentence_summary: 학습할 때만 conditional VG gate update를 teacher로 사용하고 배포 시에는 현재 gate head 한 번으로 그 선택을 근사한다.
what_we_build: 고정 decoder/amplitude에서 one- 또는 two-step conditional gate optimum을 계산하고 teacher target에는 stop-gradient를 건다.
현재 gate head에 작은 고정 가중치의 distillation loss를 추가하되 dictionary/amplitude는 기존 free energy로 학습한다.
같은 학습 compute의 nondistilled VG 및 amplitude-only refit teacher control과 비교하고 native inference 비용을 측정한다.
variants.bold_falsifiable_hypothesis: **Residual evidence에 대한 amortization gap을 학습 중 줄이면 expensive test-time correction 없이 correlated weak feature의 recall과 dictionary identity를 동시에 개선한다.**

minimal_pilot.design: Corr ±.4, 3 seeds, two gamma values, fixed-beta first. Use known-D support inference as an oracle feasibility control only, then learn D. Distill one fixed 2-step teacher; do not search many solver depths.
minimal_pilot.positive: Learned-D native one-pass model gains >=.05 signed cosine and higher support F1 at comparable hard L0; generic amplitude refit does not explain the gain; inference latency stays <=1.2x native VG within timing uncertainty.
minimal_pilot.negative: Teacher lowers free energy yet recovery does not improve, or only test-time iterative inference helps; the inference gap is not the sole barrier.
minimal_pilot.null: Teacher does not improve even fixed-D support inference or the extra optimization budget is unmatched.
minimal_pilot.prior_evidence: Previous correction pilots exceeded latency criteria and did not establish this training-only method. Their numbers are not evidence for the present hypothesis.

variants.scientific_value_even_if_negative: Offers a route to use VG residual evidence while respecting deployability; a negative result distinguishes missing amortization from the dictionary objective problem.

risk.named_failure: A better approximation to the wrong free-energy optimum can strengthen mixed representations; distillation can add cost without feature gains.

closest_prior_annotations.relation: Direct warning that encoder amortization is a known bottleneck; training-only transfer and feature identity are the specific empirical questions.

closest_prior_annotations.work: Variational Sparse Coding with Learned Thresholding
closest_prior_annotations.relation: Learned inference/thresholding is prior art; do not present residual-based sparse inference as a new invention.
Conditional gate update follows the existing objective; novelty must come from useful SAE behavior, not the sigmoid formula.

variants.title: 상관된 support posterior를 사용하는 block VG-SAE
variants.build_target: 독립 Bernoulli posterior의 표현력 한계가 correlated firing을 decoder mixing으로 떠넘기는지 해결한다.
method_steps: 5-latent pilot에서는 32 support states를 열거하여 point amplitude를 조건으로 exact variational support distribution을 최적화한다. Product Bernoulli prior는 고정해 posterior-family 효과를 분리한다.
Expected risk를 full support covariance로 계산하고 independent-Bernoulli VG와 비교한다. Rich posterior에서도 amplitude는 x-dependent point estimate이므로 full generative ELBO라고 부르지 않는다.
양성이면 2–3개 latent block을 사용하는 amortized posterior로 줄인다. Block은 train-only gate/residual 통계로 정하고 oracle true-feature grouping은 별도 upper bound로만 쓴다.
variants.hypothesis: **독립 posterior를 exact 또는 작은 block posterior로 바꾸면 같은 prior와 amplitude architecture에서 correlated support의 오판과 decoder leakage가 함께 줄며, independent-firing 조건의 효과는 작다.**

minimal_pilot.data: 5 features, d=20, width=5, latent C±.4/0, 3 worlds. All32 enumeration keeps costs tiny.
minimal_pilot.training: Mean-field amortized VG / coordinate-refined mean-field control / exact32 support VG; same amplitude network, D init, beta policy and prior grid.
minimal_pilot.primary: Signed decoder recovery, support F1/count MAE, posterior pair moments, covariance-dependent contribution to expected risk; runtime.
minimal_pilot.falsifier: Exact32가 mean-field의 같은-compute/coordinate control보다 feature identity를 개선하지 못하거나 unrelated correlations를 만들어 MSE만 낮추면 posterior dependence 가설 실패다.

variants.selection: Exact support energy uses observed x and learned parameters, never true states. Native marginal threshold>.5 is primary for comparability; joint MAP is a separately reported readout. Do not infer unknown L0 from a correct prior supplied by the generator.
variants.risk: Rich posterior may fit an already mixed dictionary better. Enumeration does not scale; block discovery can make correlated mistakes. Covariance terms can rotate decoder atoms but their direction need not favor true features.

prior_work.title: Bayesian Inference for Structured Spike and Slab Priors
prior_work.overlap: Structured support distributions are old. Sparse-but-wrong feature identity and a deployable amortized block-VG implementation would need separate evidence.

variants.so_what: 양성이면 직접 correlated support를 다루는 VG 후속 방법의 근거가 된다. 음성이면 rich support posterior만으로 dictionary identifiability 문제를 해결하지 못함을 보여주어 구조 확장을 자제할 수 있다.
variants.novelty_boundary: Exact enumeration is a tiny-world mechanism pilot, not the scalable contribution. Correlated variational sparse coding already exists.

variants.title: 평균장 가정을 완화한 joint-support VG
variants.one_sentence_summary: 작은 문제에서 32개 support의 분포를 정확히 계산하여 support 간 의존성을 학습에 반영하고, factorized VG가 놓치는 dictionary 복원 신호를 되살린다.
what_we_build: J=5에서 모든 s in {0,1}^5를 열거하고 현재 point amplitude에 조건부인 q(s|x) ∝ exp[-beta*||x-b-D(s*a)||²/2-gamma*|s|]를 계산한다.
Exact expected reconstruction, joint entropy, normalized independent prior로 decoder/amplitude를 학습하고 current amortized mean-field 및 수렴한 coordinate mean-field와 비교한다.
기존 random initialization과 작은 known mixed initialization을 모두 사용해 의존성을 허용한 학습이 혼합 방향을 벗어나는지 평가한다.
variants.bold_falsifiable_hypothesis: **Mean-field의 독립 gate 가정 때문에 잃는 support covariance를 복원하면, exact-joint VG는 최적화된 factorized VG보다 correlated toy의 mixed initialization에서 참 dictionary로 더 잘 돌아온다.**

minimal_pilot.design: Corr ±.4, 3 seeds, 2 gamma values, exact-joint vs converged mean-field vs current amortized mean-field; finite fixed beta first. J=5 enumeration is 32 states, not a scalable final solution.
minimal_pilot.positive: At comparable hard L0 exact-joint gains >=.05 signed cosine and reduces hub leakage relative to converged factorized inference, not merely the one-pass encoder.
minimal_pilot.negative: Exact joint inference preserves or prefers the mixed dictionary, or only beats the amortized head; joint covariance is then not the missing mechanism.
minimal_pilot.null: Mean-field solver has not converged or the exact state objective disagrees with explicit enumeration checks.
minimal_pilot.hard_readout: Use predeclared joint MAP support and report separate marginal >.5 readout; neither equals posterior-mean reconstruction. Costs are explicit.
minimal_pilot.mechanism_limit: With orthogonal D and independent prior, this conditional exact posterior factorizes. A gain must arise along nonorthogonal learned-D trajectories, not an asserted covariance bonus at D*.

variants.scientific_value_even_if_negative: Provides a sharp decision about whether structured VG inference is worth scaling. Even failure distinguishes mean-field/amortization limitations from the wrong-sparsity objective itself.

risk.named_failure: The exact conditional objective may have the same incorrect dictionary optimum; exponential enumeration is only a mechanism pilot, with no scalable or semantic-posterior claim.

closest_prior_annotations.relation: Direct variation of the mean-field approximation; exact inference is not by itself a new principle.
Structured/spike-slab variational inference is a neighboring family; retain the explicit point-amplitude distinction.

closest_prior_annotations.work: Learning Sparse Codes with Entropy-Based ELBOs
closest_prior_annotations.relation: Correlated variational approximations are prior art; incremental value would be measured support-covariance effects on learned feature identity.

variants.mechanism_equation: E||r-Dz||²=||r-D E[z]||²+tr(D Cov(z) D^T). Off-diagonal Cov(z) gives cross-atom terms absent from factorized Bernoulli VG; their sign does not guarantee demixing.

variants.title: 선택과 분리한 amplitude stationarity를 유지하는 VG-SAE
variants.build_target: L1을 제거해도 남는 point-amplitude의 미수렴과 gate-amplitude tradeoff를 줄인다.
method_steps: 고정 m,D에서 VG quadratic expected risk의 nonnegative amplitude coordinate optimum을 구현한다. m_j>0일 때 a_j=max(0,d_j^T r_-j/||d_j||²)이고 m_j=0에서는 식별되지 않음을 처리한다.
훈련 중 한 번의 amplitude correction을 detached target으로 amplitude head에 전달하거나 alternating amplitude step으로 사용한다. 먼저 한 선택만 고정해 public API를 유지한다.
Full VG 및 generic hard-support least-squares amplitude refit control과 비교하고 dictionary를 함께 학습한다. Test-time correction 없는 distillation 형태를 primary로 둔다.
variants.hypothesis: **입력별 amplitude stationarity를 개선하면 gate sparsity를 더 희생하지 않고 coefficient bias와 omission-induced decoder mixing을 함께 줄인다.**

minimal_pilot.data: Small±.4/0 toy; amplitude distributions rectified N(1,.15) and one skewed positive distribution; 3 paired worlds.
minimal_pilot.training: Full VG / amplitude-distilled VG / hard-support refit teacher control; same updates and a compute-matched extension.
minimal_pilot.primary: True-positive coefficient bias/MAE, signed dictionary leakage, support F1, hard-count error.
minimal_pilot.falsifier: Coefficient bias/MSE만 개선되고 feature directions나 support가 개선되지 않으면 Sparse-but-Wrong 해결 기전으로 채택하지 않는다.

variants.selection: Training correction uses only x,D,m. Oracle support refit can measure a ceiling but cannot be reported as deployable performance.
variants.risk: Small m may permit large amplitudes, and a_j update feeds back into m_j; 단일 sweep이 수렴을 보장하지 않는다. Generic amplitude refitting과 구분되는 효과가 작을 수 있다.

prior_work.overlap: An amortization gap and iterative sparse inference are known. Any new value must be the cost and effect of a specific VG update on learned feature identities.

variants.so_what: 양성이면 기존 VG의 별도 amplitude head가 필요한 수치 조건을 명확히 한다. 음성이면 amplitude debiasing alone이 correlated feature identity 문제를 고치지 못한다는 근거를 얻는다.
variants.novelty_boundary: Amplitude least squares와 selection/shrinkage 분리는 선행이다. 학습된 VG decoder의 회복 개선이 없는 단순 refit을 새 방법의 핵심으로 주장하지 않는다.

variants.title: 명시적인 slab prior와 불확실성을 갖춘 VG 확장
variants.build_target: 현재 input-dependent point amplitude가 support probability와 임의로 상쇄되는 자유도를 줄이는 probabilistic amplitude extension.
method_steps: 활성 amplitude에 lognormal prior와 lognormal variational slab을 둔다. Bernoulli support와 analytic slab moments를 이용해 E[z]=m E[a], Var(z)=m Var(a)+m(1-m)E[a]²를 계산한다.
Gaussian expected reconstruction risk에 Bernoulli KL과 m·KL(q(a|s=1,x)||p(a|s=1))를 더한다. 모든 random variables와 normalizers를 적어 proper generative extension으로 정의한다; 현행 point VG를 소급해서 ELBO라 부르지 않는다.
Point VG, slab-prior MAP-amplitude control, probabilistic-slab VG를 비교한다. Learned scalar gamma를 함께 쓰는 경우 fixed gamma 실험을 먼저 두어 prior adaptation과 slab 효과를 분리한다.
variants.hypothesis: **명시적인 slab cost는 확률과 amplitude의 보상관계를 제한하여 learned-gamma VG의 density-collapse를 줄이고, amplitude-scale shift에서 feature recovery와 hard-count 정확도를 함께 높인다.**

minimal_pilot.data: 5-feature±.4 toy; amplitude scale .5,1,2 and small observation-noise level; 3 worlds. Slab hyperparameters cannot use true support labels.
minimal_pilot.training: Three amplitude models, fixed global gamma first; one learned-gamma follow-up only if fixed-mode numerics are stable. 2,000–3,000 updates.
minimal_pilot.primary: Signed recovery, hard-count MAE, support F1, slab variance, gate-amplitude compensation statistics and conditional risk.
minimal_pilot.falsifier: MAP-slab control이 모든 이득을 설명하거나 uncertainty가 rare features를 지워 recovery를 악화하면 probabilistic slab 채택 근거가 없다.

variants.selection: Slab prior recipe is fixed on source training data. Full generative evidence-based selection is only claimed for the newly complete model, and its optimum is still not a semantic-truth guarantee.
variants.risk: 현재 VG에서 더 큰 generative model로 이동한다. VSC/VAEase 계열과 가까워지고 추가 scale hyperparameters·posterior misspecification으로 단순성을 잃을 수 있다. Lognormal prior 자체가 rectified-normal toy truth를 안다고 가정하지 않는다.

variants.so_what: 양성이면 현재 point-amplitude 조건부 위험에서 어떤 missing regularization이 support 선택을 불안정하게 만드는지 해결한다. 음성이면 더 큰 확률모형을 도입할 실용적 이유가 없으므로 단순 VG를 유지한다.
variants.novelty_boundary: Probabilistic SAE 또는 generative ELBO 최초 주장은 불가하다. VG point-amplitude limit와 비교한 identifiable failure correction이 있어야 한다.

variants.title: Amplitude 불확실성을 포함하는 spike-and-slab VG
variants.one_sentence_summary: Point amplitude 대신 nonnegative slab 분포를 사용해 작은 진폭과 부재의 혼동을 줄이는 VG 확장을 만든다.
what_we_build: 활성 상태 amplitude를 lognormal variational slab로 바꾸고 고정 lognormal prior에 대한 conditional slab KL을 추가한다; s=0 상태에 불필요한 slab KL을 부과하지 않는다.
E[z_j]=m_j E[a_j], Var(z_j)=m_j Var(a_j)+m_j(1-m_j)E[a_j]^2로 analytic reconstruction risk를 계산한다.
좁은 Normal amplitude와 넓은 positive amplitude 조건에서 point-VG 및 기존 baseline과 비교한다.
variants.bold_falsifiable_hypothesis: **Amplitude 분포가 넓고 약한 true activations가 많을 때 slab uncertainty를 표현한 VG는 point-VG보다 실제 support를 잘 분리하고, decoder가 약한 feature를 이웃에 섞는 현상을 줄인다.**

minimal_pilot.design: Common toy corr ±.4, 3 seeds, two amplitude regimes: rectified Normal(1,.15) versus mean-matched lognormal with preregistered dispersion. Two gamma values, fixed finite beta; prior parameters selected without truth and shared across worlds.
minimal_pilot.positive: Broad-amplitude regime improves rare/weak activation recall plus signed dictionary cosine >=.05 at comparable hard L0 without merely adding extra false-positive support.
minimal_pilot.negative: Only coefficient uncertainty improves while feature identity remains mixed, or the slab KL reintroduces harmful amplitude bias.
minimal_pilot.null: Variational variance collapses against the precision floor or MC verification disagrees with analytic moments.
minimal_pilot.scope: This is a different probabilistic model with an explicit amplitude prior; only after the complete likelihood/prior/KL derivation may this variant be called a full ELBO. Do not retroactively give that label to current VG.

variants.scientific_value_even_if_negative: Tests whether VG point amplitudes are a beneficial simplicity choice or the barrier to reliable feature identity under realistic magnitude variation.

risk.named_failure: This approaches established variational sparse coding; a more expensive posterior may not improve dictionary recovery and new slab-prior choices may dominate.

closest_prior_annotations.relation: Direct spike-and-slab prior; a generic variational slab is not novel.
Gaussian uncertainty gates/noise learning are established alternatives; difference must be tied to Bernoulli inclusion and the stated recovery failure.

closest_prior_annotations.work: Learning Sparse Codes with Entropy-Based ELBOs
closest_prior_annotations.relation: Analytic entropy-based sparse objectives and uncertainty learning are prior art, not a reason to discard the test.

variants.title: 전역 precision으로 support 비용을 일관되게 유지하는 VG 학습
variants.build_target: correlated active count가 minibatch-profiled beta를 바꾸어 support와 dictionary를 함께 왜곡하는지 확인하고 개선한다.
method_steps: 동일 VG network에 (a) current per-minibatch profiled beta, (b) global learned beta, (c) train-only running expected-risk로 갱신하는 detached global beta를 구현한다. 서로 다른 objective/estimator임을 명시한다.
각 batch의 support-count 편차, expected risk와 beta 변화를 기록한다. Batch size와 correlated-support 조건을 교차해 global beta의 효과를 확인한다.
선택한 global-beta recipe를 gamma grid 전체에 적용하고, 같은 achieved-L0에서 decoder recovery를 다시 비교한다. 단순 beta initialization 변화와 구별한다.
variants.hypothesis: **active-count 변동이 큰 correlated data에서 global precision은 minibatch profiling보다 support-count fluctuation과 signed feature leakage를 줄이며, 그 차이는 batch가 커질수록 작아진다.**

minimal_pilot.data: 5-feature positive/negative correlation plus independent control; p=.4; 3 worlds, batch sizes64 and512.
minimal_pilot.training: Three precision policies, same initialization and examples; limited gamma controls. Current P2 moment-initialization trials are not new evidence for this hypothesis.
minimal_pilot.primary: Signed recovery, support F1/count MAE; beta/count covariance; boundary/floor hits; paired sample-budget and step-budget results.
minimal_pilot.falsifier: Global precision reduces beta variance but feature recovery does not improve, or large-batch convergence contradicts the proposed coupling mechanism.

variants.selection: Beta moments use training data only and no L0 labels. Gamma selection remains an independent issue; this route does not claim unknown-L0 identification.
variants.risk: Profiled vs global objectives differ inherently, not just numerical noise. Positive result may be optimization hygiene with limited scientific novelty; noiseless tiny-toy floors can dominate.

variants.so_what: 양성이면 VG support cost의 실제 의미를 안정화하는 저복잡도 recipe다. 음성이면 기존 beta 학습 구조를 유지하고 더 본질적인 support/identifiability 문제에 집중한다.
variants.novelty_boundary: Noise profiling/global precision은 선행이다. 새 contribution의 독립 핵심으로 과장하지 말고 VG feature recovery를 좌우하는 설계 요소로 취급한다.

variants.title: feature 재현성으로 sparsity prior를 고르는 배포 가능한 VG 선택 규칙
variants.build_target: true L0와 feature labels가 없는 조건에서 VG operating point를 선택하는 training wrapper.
method_steps: 미리 고정한 작은 gamma grid에서 같은 VG를 두 독립 train resample 또는 initialization으로 학습한다. Each grid cell gets the same number of checkpoints.
Calibration x만 사용하여 decoder matching 안정성, gate co-firing agreement와 nontrivial coverage를 계산한다. Low-activity collapse를 막는 규칙과 fidelity admissibility floor를 source에서 고정한다.
해당 안정성 규칙으로 gamma/checkpoint를 골라 fresh test의 true recovery와 비교한다. c_dec selector, validation-MSE selector, oracle recovery ceiling을 동일 후보 집합에 적용한다.
variants.hypothesis: **레이블 없이 선택한 VG의 feature 안정성은 validation MSE 또는 c_dec 단독 선택보다 correlation/density shift에서 oracle feature-recovery 선택에 더 가까운 operating point를 고른다.**

minimal_pilot.data: 5-feature±.4/0, p=.2,.4,.6의 일부 사전 지정 transfer cells, 3 worlds. Reuse A01/A02 checkpoints where seeds/splits fit; do not reuse test for selection.
minimal_pilot.training: 3–5 gamma values ×2 replicas; final checkpoint first to limit multiplicity. Freeze scalar combination/tie-break rules before seeing target labels.
minimal_pilot.primary: Oracle regret in signed dictionary recovery and support F1; hard-count MAE; leakage of chosen model; collapse/overcomplete wrong-stability rate.
minimal_pilot.falsifier: 안정적인 mixed dictionary, identity rotation 또는 dead latents를 반복적으로 선호하거나 c_dec/MSE selection보다 oracle regret를 줄이지 못하면 selector를 기각한다.

variants.selection: Deployable selection sees only train/calibration x and model states. Oracle regret and true L0 are evaluation-only. Fidelity floor is an admissibility rule, not the optimized success metric.
variants.risk: Stable wrong features are possible, especially under strong correlation or misspecified width. Ensemble cost grows with the grid; the rule adds a selection hyperparameter and does not prove identifiability.

prior_work.title: Sparse but Wrong: Incorrect L0 Leads to Incorrect Features in Sparse Autoencoders
prior_work.overlap: Wrong sparsity can favor mixed dictionaries; c_dec selection and high-to-low sparsity scheduling are already discussed. The paper establishes neither general L1 failure nor VG correctness.

prior_work.title: Toward Identifiable Sparse Autoencoders
prior_work.overlap: SAE instability/identifiability is already studied; prior registry read level is abstract only, so method-level overlap needs follow-up.

prior_work.title: Jumping Ahead: Improving Reconstruction Fidelity with JumpReLU Sparse Autoencoders
prior_work.overlap: Learned thresholds and sparse nonshrinking activations are established. Sparse but Wrong uses an Anthropic-style tanh sparsity implementation; identify that implementation separately from a generic JumpReLU label.

variants.so_what: 양성이면 synthetic oracle의 좋은 VG를 실제 labels 없는 사용으로 연결한다. 음성이면 안정성/c_dec 같은 unsupervised proxy의 한계를 인정하고 deployable selection 해결을 별도 미완료로 남긴다.
variants.novelty_boundary: Feature stability라는 일반 진단이 novelty가 아니다. 이 wrapper가 original VG-SAE deployment의 unknown-L0 문제를 실제로 줄이는지가 기여이며 별도 diagnostic-paper로 전환하지 않는다.

variants.title: 독립 학습 간 feature 재현성으로 VG operating point 고르기
variants.one_sentence_summary: True features를 모르는 상황에서 서로 다른 training subsample과 initialization에 반복해서 나타나는 VG atom을 기준으로 gamma를 선택한다.
what_we_build: 각 gamma에 두 작은 bootstrap training runs를 학습하고 unit decoder와 held-out activation pattern을 unlabeled Hungarian matching으로 맞춘다.
사전 정한 reconstruction floor를 만족하는 후보에서 atom 방향과 firing-pattern 재현성을 결합한 고정 기준을 최대화한다; dead 또는 constant atoms는 matching에 따로 처리한다.
선택 후에만 hidden truth를 열어 feature identity와 signed mixing을 검증하고 c_dec selector 및 oracle upper bound와 비교한다.
variants.bold_falsifiable_hypothesis: **독립 데이터·초기화에서 반복되는 방향과 firing pattern은 VG의 낮은 loss 또는 낮은 c_dec보다 참 feature 복원을 잘 예측하여 unknown-L0 선택의 oracle gap을 줄인다.**

minimal_pilot.design: Corr ±.4, 3 outer paired worlds, 3 gamma values, 2 bootstrap fits each; use all runs for selection cost accounting. Fixed reconstruction floor comes from an unlabeled dense fit and is reported as a hyperparameter.
minimal_pilot.positive: Frozen stability selector improves selected-test signed cosine >=.05 and lowers leakage versus fixed gamma/c_dec in >=2/3 worlds per sign, while retaining coverage; all stability-to-truth correlations are reported.
minimal_pilot.negative: The same mixed dictionary is highly stable, stability favors too few common features, or selection loses rare features despite apparently good matching.
minimal_pilot.null: Runs fail to converge or stable candidates all violate the fixed reconstruction floor; report no selection.
minimal_pilot.unlabeled_selection: Cross-model matching uses no D*, support labels, or true L0. Ground-truth matching occurs only after the operating point is frozen.

variants.scientific_value_even_if_negative: Supplies an implementable VG selection layer if it works and a precise stable-but-wrong failure boundary if it does not, without changing the central VG-SAE research into a diagnostic paper.

risk.named_failure: Optimization may consistently converge to the same wrong mixed dictionary; bootstrap agreement is not semantic identification.

closest_prior_annotations.relation: Feature stability/identity is a direct neighboring target; only abstract-level scope is verified in supplied literature, so do not claim a stronger theorem comparison.
A stable low-MSE mixed dictionary is possible; tests whether a different unlabeled signal adds information.
Already frames sparsity as model selection; this is a specific stability criterion requiring later closest-prior checking.

variants.title: 발화 의존성을 prior에 담는 VG
variants.one_sentence_summary: 현재 독립 Bernoulli prior를 작은 pairwise support prior로 교체하여 상관을 decoder 혼합으로 대신 설명해야 하는 압력을 줄인다.
what_we_build: J=5의 support prior를 p(s) ∝ exp[-gamma*sum(s)+sum_{i<j} W_ij s_i s_j]로 바꾸고 32-state log partition을 정확히 계산한다.
Posterior와 amplitude head는 현재 mean-field VG 그대로 두고 W를 unlabeled training data에서 학습한다; true correlation graph는 제공하지 않는다.
Independent-prior와 pairwise-prior 조건을 같은 initialization에서 비교하고 learned support dependence와 decoder leakage를 따로 기록한다.
variants.bold_falsifiable_hypothesis: **True firing dependence를 support prior가 설명할 수 있으면 같은 hard L0에서 상관된 feature를 섞는 decoder가 덜 선호되어, independent-prior VG보다 signed feature recovery가 높아진다.**

minimal_pilot.design: Corr 0/±.4, 3 seeds, 2 fixed gamma values; scalar prior vs 10-parameter pairwise prior. One weak fixed W regularization level is preregistered; report that new hyperparameter and width limit.
minimal_pilot.positive: Both correlation signs show reduced leakage with higher identity in >=2/3 seeds, while the independent condition does not lose >.03 signed cosine; comparison is density-matched.
minimal_pilot.negative: W explains away the same mixed representation, reinforces false gate coactivation, or gain disappears after density matching.
minimal_pilot.null: Log partition or W estimates are numerically unstable; explicit 32-state normalization/moment checks must pass before interpretation.
minimal_pilot.unlabeled_selection: No true graph or support goes into W training; knowing the toy hub is for evaluation only. Oracle graph arm, if used, is labeled an oracle upper bound.

variants.scientific_value_even_if_negative: Clarifies whether a factorized support prior is an essential mismatch for VG-SAE under correlated features and whether modeling firing dependence can preserve dictionary identity.

risk.named_failure: Support correlation estimated from a wrong encoder can be self-confirming; learned correlations might reduce pressure to disentangle rather than increase it.

closest_prior_annotations.relation: Motivates separating firing dependence from dictionary geometry, but does not establish a correlated-prior solution.

closest_prior_annotations.work: The Variational Garrote / structured sparse coding
closest_prior_annotations.relation: A modification of the prior, not a claim that pairwise binary models or correlated sparse coding are new; specific nearest structured-prior studies need later novelty search.

variants.title: Native hard code에 맞춰 decoder를 학습하는 VG
variants.one_sentence_summary: Gate와 amplitude는 VG free energy로 추정하되 decoder 업데이트는 실제 배포하는 hard code의 재구성 오차로 수행한다.
what_we_build: 매 minibatch에서 encoder/gate/amplitude step은 기존 full VG loss를 사용한다.
Decoder step은 detached native hard code 1[m>.5]*a를 고정하고 hard SSE로 업데이트한 뒤 unit norm을 유지한다.
원래 joint training과 같은 업데이트 수·비용으로 비교하고 soft-trained dictionary와 hard deployment 사이의 recovery 차이를 측정한다.
variants.bold_falsifiable_hypothesis: **Mean code와 hard code의 차이가 큰 VG 조건에서는 hard-readout에 맞춘 decoder 업데이트가 deployment support 누락을 보상하는 방향 혼합을 줄이고 true-feature identity를 개선한다.**

minimal_pilot.design: Corr ±.4, 3 seeds, two gamma values with appreciable gate uncertainty chosen from calibration entropy only; current training versus two-block training, plus near-binary gate control.
minimal_pilot.positive: Hard-code decoder training improves signed cosine >=.05, leakage and hard support F1 at matched hard L0; the effect is strongest where mean-hard gap was large.
minimal_pilot.negative: It increases mixing because hard omission strengthens missing-feature pressure, or gains arise only from more optimizer work.
minimal_pilot.null: All gates saturate immediately, removing the proposed mismatch; test a documented uncertainty regime before interpretation.
minimal_pilot.objective_honesty: The block updates use different objectives. Do not claim coordinate descent on the original VG free energy, an ELBO, or guaranteed monotonic descent.

variants.scientific_value_even_if_negative: Determines whether the current training-to-inference mismatch is a correctable source of feature error, with a deployable method if positive and an explicit reason to keep expected-risk decoder training if negative.

risk.named_failure: Hard omission can strengthen exactly the Sparse but Wrong pressure; separate block objectives can oscillate.

closest_prior_annotations.relation: Warns that hard omissions can create mixed dictionary optima; this is a falsifiable alternative update, not an assumed cure.
Separate support/amplitude training and auxiliary pathways are nearby; compare the concrete gradient routes.
Direct hard activation training competitor; hard decoding alone cannot be claimed as new.

variants.title: Gate 불확실성으로 prior 강도를 선택하는 VG
variants.one_sentence_summary: VG의 entropy와 support sensitivity를 gamma sweep에서 측정하고 feature 회복 구간을 예측하는 unlabeled operating-point 규칙으로 시험한다.
what_we_build: 같은 training budget의 짧은 gamma continuation에서 held-out unlabeled gate entropy와 gamma에 대한 gate-mass 변화를 저장한다.
사전 고정한 규칙으로 plateau 경계 또는 첫 stable low-uncertainty operating point를 고른다; label로 threshold를 조정하지 않는다.
동일 후보 집합의 c_dec 선택, fixed gamma, oracle-cal recovery와 별도 비교해 correlation/density transfer에서 일반화되는지 본다.
variants.bold_falsifiable_hypothesis: **VG의 support 전이 신호는 단순 c_dec minimum보다 feature recovery가 좋은 operating point를 일관되게 선택하며, 처음 보는 correlation과 density에서도 true L0 없이 작동한다.**

minimal_pilot.design: Reuse selected B01 checkpoints only if continuation protocol fits; otherwise 7 gamma values x 2 correlations x 3 seeds with a fixed total update budget. Pre-register a single rule before viewing recovery curves: choose the smallest gamma after the dominant decrease of mean gate mass where unlabeled entropy is below a fixed source-defined level and hard SSE remains within a fixed tolerance of the dense source fit.
minimal_pilot.positive: Unlabeled choice stays within .05 signed cosine of oracle-cal selection in at least 2/3 seeds across both signs and outperforms fixed source gamma/c_dec selection without systematically missing true features.
minimal_pilot.negative: The transition identifies confident but mixed/dead features, depends strongly on sweep direction, or does not transfer.
minimal_pilot.null: No stable transition or acceptable-fidelity point exists; report selector abstention, do not silently use the oracle.
minimal_pilot.scope: The fidelity tolerance and entropy threshold are still selection hyperparameters. This is not a hyperparameter-free automatic true-L0 theorem.

variants.scientific_value_even_if_negative: Uses a distinctive accessible VG quantity to make the method operable without support labels, while a negative result reveals whether uncertainty is informative or simply confidence in the wrong code.

risk.named_failure: Low entropy can indicate confident wrong mixing; arbitrary transition rules can smuggle oracle tuning back into selection.

closest_prior_annotations.work: VG for Statistical Physics-based Sparse and Robust Variable Selection
closest_prior_annotations.relation: Selection-uncertainty/transition signals already proposed for regression; extension to learned SAE dictionaries is the unresolved question.
Already investigates c_dec control. Compare selector generalization rather than claiming first sparsity controller.
Competing unlabeled selection philosophies; their remaining tuning choices should be described as fairly as VG thresholds.
